thread:
maria: Quick pre-con sync — we need to lock vendor dropoff windows, final speaker asks, and swag staging times for next week. Can people confirm availability?

devin: I can take point on vendor dropoffs. Shipping cutoff from our vendor is Thu 10am PST. I proposed two slots for our dock: Fri 8–10am or Fri 4–6pm. Prefer the morning. :truck: 

kevin: Morning works. Heads up — demo rig needs GPU drivers update before shipping, will take ~45m on arrival. Add that as a check.

jess: Speaker asks — I emailed the panelists this morning: request for slides (+ demo creds) by Wed EOD, ask for a 5-min dry run Thu. Two speakers asked for HDMI adapters. I have 6 spares in kit.

sam: For swag staging: where do we want the unboxed inventory dropped? Last event we had overflow in the storage closet and it clogged walkways. Suggest meeting room B as staging and then move to booth 1hr before open.

maria: Good call. Meeting room B reserved Fri 7am-12pm. Devin — can you accept delivery there and sign? Also add a note to logistics-bot to send reminder to volunteers at 7:30am.

devin: Yep, accepting. I will also tag our on-site lead @zara. Zara, can you confirm volunteer roster and dropoff help?

zara: I have 6 volunteers confirmed. Two can do heavy lifting (lift certified). I'll run a 15-min orientation Fri 8:15am in Meeting room B. Volunteers will then stage swag and assemble demo stand.

maria: Cool. Demo schedule draft (finalize by Wed):
```
Fri 9:30am — booth open, welcome demo loop (10m)
Fri 11:00am — 30m deep-dive session (with live benchmarking script)
Fri 1:30pm — speaker lightning talks (3x10m)
Fri 4:00pm — customer office hours (by sign-up)
```

kevin: For the benchmarking session, we'll run the light model and full model comparison. Need a short runbook for SRE in case the network flaps. I'll attach commands here later.

jess: Reminder: PR & social — we have a prewritten launch post but need final quote from Gaurav. Also, confirm photography window for 11:00-11:20 for hero shots. @maria can you approve the quote ask?

maria: Approved. Jess, ping Gaurav now so we get it by Tue. Photographer booked for 11:00-11:20.

sam: Vendor pickups — shipping labels and returns: can we print returns labels onsite? We should have prepaid return labels for demo hardware. Devin, can you confirm we have the prepaid account?

devin: Yes, account active. I'll prepare a batch of return labels and a manifest. Planning to print in Meeting room B at 8:30am.

zara: Volunteer checklist I will hand out (short):
- arrival 7:45am
- safety + lifting demo 8:15am
- badge + comms (channel #event-ops)
- swag counts and bagging targets
- demo handoff at 9:10am

maria: Awesome. One last item — inbound lead routing: can SalesOps confirm form and webhook mapping? We want leads tagged with "conference:city-spring" and routed to AE queue with SLA 24h.

jess: I already created the Typeform draft. Need webhook endpoint. @devin can share the endpoint from the demo laptop or we can use staging endpoint.

devin: Will share staging webhook by Tue. Also adding simple dedupe based on email/hash to avoid duplicates from signups + card scans.

maria: OK — action items recap:
- Devin: accept drops, prepare return labels, share webhook, dock window Fri 8–10am (confirmed)
- Zara: volunteer roster + orientation + checklist
- Kevin: GPU driver + SRE runbook + bench commands
- Jess: finalize PR quote, get Gaurav's quote, confirm photographer
- Sam: swag staging plan and meeting room B coordination
- All: confirm slides & dry run by Wed EOD

devin: Noted. I'll also add a quick printed label on each demo box: "DO NOT OPEN until 8:30am" to avoid early unboxing.

maria: Perfect. Logistics-bot: reminder set for Fri 7:30am -> volunteers, 8:30am -> label printing, 9:00am -> final booth check.

logistics-bot: Reminder scheduled: Fri 07:30 meeting-room-B "Volunteer orientation"; Fri 08:30 meeting-room-B "Print labels & stage swag"; Fri 09:00 booth-1 "Final booth check". :robot_face:

jess: Thanks team — I'll post the final checklist and the social timeline once I have the quote. :sparkles:

zara: see you all Fri!
